jobs.description:
**Role: Sr. Azure Data Engineer with Databricks**

**Experience: -** Min 8+ Years

**Location: -** Chicago, IL (Hybrid 3 days' Work from Office)

Seeking a **Senior Data Engineer** with deep expertise in SQL Server, Azure SQL, and Databricks to design, optimize, and deliver scalable cloud-based data solutions supporting analytics and enterprise data platforms

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Database Development & Optimization:** Design, develop, and maintain complex **SQL Server and Azure SQL** databases.

Write and optimize advanced **T-SQL** queries, stored procedures, functions, and views.

Perform **query tuning, indexing strategies, and performance optimization** for large-scale datasets.

Implement best practices for **database security, data integrity, and reliability**.

**Cloud & Data Platform**: Develop and manage data solutions in **Azure SQL Database**.

Work with **Databricks (Apache Spark)** to support data transformations, analytics, and largescale data processing.

Integrate Azure SQL with Databricks using **Delta Lake, Spark SQL, and PySpark/SQL** where applicable.

Support cloud-based data architectures and hybrid data environments.

**Data Modelling & Warehousing:** Design and maintain **relational and dimensional data models**.

Implement **Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)** and other data warehousing patterns.

Support ETL/ELT processes and collaborate with data engineering teams.

**Collaboration & Leadership:** Partner with application developers, data engineers, BI teams, and stakeholders to understand data requirements.

Provide guidance and mentoring to junior developers.

Participate in code reviews and enforce database development standards.

Troubleshoot production issues and provide root cause analysis.

**Educational Qualifications: -**

Engineering Degree BE/ME/BTech/MTech/BSc/MSc.

Technical certification in multiple technologies is desirable.

**Skills: -**

Mandatory skills

min 8**+ years** of experience as a Database Developer or similar role.

Strong expertise in **SQL Server and Azure SQL**.

Advanced proficiency in **T-SQL**, including performance tuning and query optimization.

Hands-on experience with **Databricks** and **Apache Spark**.

Solid understanding of **data warehousing concepts**, dimensional modelling, and SCD.

Experience working in **Azure cloud environments**.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Client Interview can happen Virtual but candidate needs to relocate to Chicago, IL from day 1.**

jobs.title: Data Engineer III
jobs.description:
Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team works to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
As a Data Engineer III on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for...  

* Designing, developing, testing, and maintaining batch and near-real-time data pipelines using modern data engineering tools and frameworks
* Building and optimizing data models, schemas, and storage solutions to support analytics, reporting, and artificial intelligence use cases
* Integrating data from multiple structured and unstructured sources while ensuring data quality, lineage, and consistency across platforms
* Supporting cloud-based data platform implementation activities, including deployment, monitoring, performance tuning, incident management, and issue resolution
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to translate business and technical requirements into scalable data engineering solutions and support delivery across project workstreams

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  
**The team**  
  
Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.  
  
Our AI & Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
Required:  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related technical field and 5+ years of experience developing, testing, and deploying data pipelines and extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes
* 4+ years of experience in incident management
* 4+ years of experience in data management
* 4+ years of experience in data ingestion
* 4+ years of experience leading technical teams or workstreams
* 4+ years of experience managing stakeholder relationships
* Active Secret security clearance with full adjudication
* Ability to travel 0-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  
Preferred:  

* 4+ years of experience in digital transformation
* 4+ years of experience in process optimization
* 4+ years of experience in technical analysis

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400 to $207,800.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer, AI Enablement
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**About AbbVie**

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology, and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

 **Job Description**

The Principal Data Engineer, AI Enablement will design, develop, and maintain data solutions that drive the advancement and enablement of our AI and machine learning use cases. In this role, you will collaborate closely with data engineers, data scientists, architects, and business analysts to advance the core data capabilities, deliver projects, foster technological innovation, and promote continuous improvement.

**Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with a cross-functional team of engineers, architects, data scientists, business system analysts and product owners to understand requirements and deliver fit-for-purpose solutions.
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable AI-ready data solutions for diverse data sets to support pharma value chain.
* Design, develop, and maintain solutions involving the integration of LLMs (such as GPT or Claude or similar technologies) for data mining, knowledge extraction, and automation of data-driven insights.
* Design, develop, and maintain solutions to operationalize machine learning models, including model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
* Capture and interpret user requirements into expressive data models that enable graph analytics, semantic reasoning, and GenAI integration.
* Research and recommend appropriate tools, frameworks, and platforms for graph databases, vector stores, and large language models integration including agent-based solutions.
* Provide technical leadership, act as a subject matter expert and advisor to partners on the feasibility and impact of emerging technologies in the AI data space.
* Ensure compliance with applicable AbbVie software development, lifecycle policies, and procedures.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Bachelor's Degree with 8 years of experience; OR Master's Degree with 7 years of experience; OR PhD with 3 years of related work experience and a strong understanding of specified functional area.
* Must have experience with MLOps, LLM integration, Data Agents, Agentic Memory and Graph RAG systems, text mining, and unstructured data processing.
* Experience designing and building data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and data models.
* Proficiency with Python, SQL, and distributed data processing frameworks such as Spark.
* Experience with CI/CD practices, data quality controls, governance, and security considerations.

**Preferred:**

* Degree in Computer Science or related discipline preferred. Advanced degree preferred.
* Experience with Neo4j & Elasticsearch database technologies is preferred.
* AWS experience is preferred.

This range may be modified in the future.

The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law.

jobs.title: Data Science Engineer
jobs.description:
**Full Time** position in 1 North Wacker Drive Chicago, IL, 60606

**Job Title: Data Science Engineer**
  
*Location: Chicago, IL-Remote/Hybrid*

**About Us:**

At **Predictive Sales AI (PSAI)**, we’re redefining how technology and intelligence transform digital marketing. Our AI-powered software enables home services businesses to make smarter, faster decisions—fueling growth through automation, prediction, and precision.

We are seeking a **Data Science Engineer** with strong data engineering and MLOps expertise to build scalable, production-grade ML and data platforms that directly impact customer growth and retention.

**Job Overview:**

As a **Data Science Engineer**, you will design and operate the data + machine learning foundations behind PSAI’s predictive products. You will build scalable pipelines and robust warehouse/lakehouse models across CRM, marketing, product events, and external datasets — ensuring reliability, accuracy, and business continuity at scale.

**This role requires:**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* 4+ years in data-centric engineering
* Proven experience deploying ML models via pipelines
* Deep expertise in Python, SQL, and Azure infrastructure
* Architectural ownership through data contracts and resilient modeling

* Build scalable batch and near-real-time ingestion pipelines using Azure Data Factory, APIs, event streams, and external connectors.
* Develop ML-ready datasets across CRM, marketing automation platforms, product telemetry, and geospatial data sources.
* Design performant, well-modeled warehouse/lakehouse systems in Azure Synapse or Databricks.
* Train and deploy predictive models (lead scoring, churn prediction, forecasting) through reproducible pipelines.
* Build time-aware, leakage-resistant feature pipelines for production ML use cases.
* Support full MLOps lifecycle using Azure Machine Learning, including experiment tracking, model registry, and deployment.
* Implement automated validation, anomaly detection, reconciliation, and monitoring for pipelines and warehouse models.
* Design and enforce data contracts to prevent upstream schema changes from breaking downstream ML workflows.
* Own pipeline SLAs, alerting, incident response, and durable improvements through postmortems.
* Optimize processing for very large datasets (>100GB) through partitioning, incremental loads, distributed compute, and query tuning.
* Improve cost efficiency across compute/storage in Azure environments.
* Maintain clean, testable, production-ready Python codebases using:
* Object-oriented patterns
* Type hinting
* CI/CD workflows via Azure DevOps
* Package models and pipelines using Docker for consistent deployment across dev/staging/prod.
* Communicate architectural trade-offs and technical debt in business terms to Product, RevOps, and leadership.
* Partner with Engineering on instrumentation and scalable data integration.
* Mentor junior engineers through pairing, code reviews, and documentation best practices.

**Desired Traits:**

We are looking for an individual who is organized, proactive, and detail-oriented. In this role, you will work closely with teams across the company. Here’s what we’re looking for:

* Ownership mindset with a reliability-first approach
* Strong SQL/Python and a high attention to data quality
* Scales systems thoughtfully (performance/cost aware, maintainable designs)
* Collaborative communicator across engineering, RevOps, and analytics
* Documents well and supports others through reviews/mentorship

**Required Skills and Experience:**

* **Preferred Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a closely related quantitative field.**
* 4+ years in data engineering, ML engineering, or data platform development.
* Minimum 2 years deploying ML models into production workflows.
* Experience building pipelines and warehouse systems at scale (>100GB datasets).
* Demonstrated adaptability in fast-changing technical and business environments.
* Python (Expert): pandas, polars, scikit-learn; PyTorch, transformers; production engineering (OOP, testing, typing)
* SQL (Expert): advanced analytics, recursive CTEs, query tuning, Azure Synapse optimization
* Azure Data & ML Stack: Data Factory (ETL/ELT), Azure ML (MLOps), Key Vault, Databricks/Spark, Docker deployment
* Distributed & Large-Scale Compute: Spark, Ray, Dask; GPU acceleration with RAPIDS (plus)
* Geospatial & Specialized Data: GeoPandas, Shapely, rasterio
* AI Automation & LLMs: LangChain/Semantic Kernel, agentic workflows
* DevOps & CI/CD: Azure DevOps pipelines, Gitflow, rebasing, clean version control

**Why Join Us?**

* **Innovative Environment:** Be part of a forward-thinking company that values creativity and encourages the exploration of new ideas.
* **Professional Growth:** Access opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement within a supportive and dynamic team.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Enjoy a competitive salary, performance-based bonuses, flexible work arrangements, and a robust benefits package.
* **Collaborative Culture:** Work in a team-oriented environment where collaboration and mutual respect drive our success.

If you're ready to be part of an innovative, growth-oriented team, apply today!

Apply for Data Science Engineer

**Complete Online Application**
  
Please complete the application to apply for Data Science Engineer at Predictive Sales AI, LLC.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Umain**
---------------

Umain, part of Eidra, is a digital product consultancy with nearly 200 engineers, designers, and product strategists. We partner with companies including McDonald’s, Polestar, Heineken, Rijksmuseum, Spotify, and Philips Hue to shape, build, and scale the products and platforms their businesses and customers rely on. We work in small, senior teams, staying with a product from its first idea through launch and beyond.

Umain is growing its AI engineering team in the US. Our AI engineers around the world design, prototype and build AI-powered tools and software that change how clients work, from advanced GenAI workflows and custom agents to production-ready AI applications. You'll join a global team of more than 30 AI engineers across Sweden, the Netherlands, Norway, and North America, working alongside strategy consultants, marketers, data experts and designers.

This full time role is based in Chicago at our West Loop office. As part of Umain's expanding U.S. footprint, you'll help establish our reputation for engineering excellence, strategy, and delivery in the American market. You must be in Chicago or willing to relocate to be considered for this role as we require a minimum of 3 days in-office per week.

**Your role**
-------------

As an AI Engineer at Umain, you’ll build the next generation of AI-powered products, workflows, and agents for our clients, combining strong software engineering fundamentals and full-stack product thinking with modern AI capabilities. Your work will range from integrating LLMs and vision models to architecting agents, building scalable pipelines and experimenting with new techniques.

You’ll turn ambiguous ideas into robust solutions, evaluate where AI truly adds value and help clients understand what is possible, feasible, and responsible—all while playing an active role in shaping our growing AI practice.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Partner with clients to clarify their challenges, decide whether AI is the right answer and assess feasibility and risk, including data security, privacy, licensing, and responsible AI.
* Design, prototype, build, and ship AI-powered applications, workflows, and agents for clients ranging from start-ups to global enterprises.
* Architect agentic systems, including context management, memory, orchestration, and the tools, skills, and MCP integrations agents rely on.
* Select, integrate, and adapt foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others). Fine-tune or combine them when off-the-shelf options fall short.
* Design around model limitations in both the architecture and the product's UX. Apply techniques like retrieval, chunking, embeddings, and redlining, and debug AI systems when they misbehave.
* Build evaluation and observability into everything you ship. Use stochastic test cases, trace-based analysis, and tools to benchmark and monitor models, prompts, and agents.
* Build the software, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (Azure, GCP, or AWS) that keep AI products running reliably at scale.
* Own parts of project delivery, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and lead client and internal workshops.
* Bring technical credibility to new business. You'll join pitches as our AI expert, shape proposals and RFP responses, and help prospective clients see what's possible.
* Help define Umain's AI offerings and grow the competence through internal frameworks, playbooks, knowledge sessions, and engineering standards.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Partner with clients to clarify their challenges, decide whether AI is the right answer and assess feasibility and risk, including data security, privacy, licensing, and responsible AI.
* Design, prototype, build, and ship AI-powered applications, workflows, and agents for clients ranging from start-ups to global enterprises.
* Architect agentic systems, including context management, memory, orchestration, and the tools, skills, and MCP integrations agents rely on.
* Select, integrate, and adapt foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others). Fine-tune or combine them when off-the-shelf options fall short.
* Design around model limitations in both the architecture and the product's UX. Apply techniques like retrieval, chunking, embeddings, and redlining, and debug AI systems when they misbehave.
* Build evaluation and observability into everything you ship. Use stochastic test cases, trace-based analysis, and tools to benchmark and monitor models, prompts, and agents.
* Build the software, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (Azure, GCP, or AWS) that keep AI products running reliably at scale.
* Own parts of project delivery, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and lead client and internal workshops.
* Bring technical credibility to new business. You'll join pitches as our AI expert, shape proposals and RFP responses, and help prospective clients see what's possible.
* Help define Umain's AI offerings and grow the competence through internal frameworks, playbooks, knowledge sessions, and engineering standards.

**What you bring**
------------------

* Approximately 8 years engineering experience that includes at least 4 years building AI-powered systems, or equivalent hands-on experience shipping AI in production systems.
* Hands-on experience with LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, prompt and context engineering, retrieval setups, fine-tuning, and model evaluation.
* Experience building agents, including memory, tool use, and orchestration, with at least one modern agent framework.
* Experience integrating AI services such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and Meta models.
* Strong software engineering skills in TypeScript and/or Python, including real backend systems and data pipelines.
* Full-stack product thinking: frontend or backend experience outside the traditional AI field, and the ability to build end to end.
*

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* 7 years of experience working with patent data in a corporate or law firm environment.
* 7 years of experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 9 years of experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP), Large Language Models (LLMs), semantic search, or knowledge graph extraction.

**About the job**
-----------------

Help serve Google's worldwide user base of more than a billion people. Data Scientists provide quantitative support, market understanding and a strategic perspective to our partners throughout the organization. As a data-loving member of the team, you serve as an analytics expert for your partners, using numbers to help them make better decisions. You will weave stories with meaningful insight from data. You'll make critical recommendations for your fellow Googlers in Engineering and Product Management. You relish tallying up the numbers one minute and communicating your findings to a team leader the next.
  
  
Google’s Global Patents Team is an inspiring team of innovators and attorneys who are passionate about future technologies and excited about resolving their ensuing legal challenges. As a member of this team, you will have the unique opportunity to develop and implement Google's strategy to protect, defend and capture the value of Google’s technological innovation. You will dive into varied and interesting tasks that include patent-related protection, licensing, dispute resolution, acquisition, deals and policy work.
  
  
As a Senior Global Patents Data Scientist, you will be focusing on applied data and AI solution creations and experimentations. You will use a variety of tools and languages to make sense of large amounts of patent data, one of largest legal data corpus in history, generate AI enabled patent-specific applications, contribute to novel statistical and machine learning models, work closely with subject matter experts and stakeholders to constantly search for ways to make existing workflows and processes more efficient with AI.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive the implementation of patent AI transformation initiatives focusing on patent prosecution and patent transaction use cases.
* Apply patent and AI expertise to support patent engagement with the academic community and various patent offices on empirical patent and innovation studies and advise on AI implementations.
* Work with public patent data, internal data and tool stack to create custom AI solutions to support patent portfolio strategy, development, quality reviews and other patent workflows.
* Leverage patent expertise to develop internal patent transactions specific solutions to review third-party patent and licensing inquiries.
* Collaborate with outside counsel, internal legal team members, dedicated patent specialist vendors to achieve scaled impact.

new_jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist, Global Patents
new_jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short-Term Disability + Baby Bonding): 28-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year

  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Seattle, WA, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; Washington D.C., DC, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Engineering, Sciences, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience working with patent data in a corporate or law firm environment.
* 7 years of experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis.
* Experience working with a national patent offices or academic institutions studying patent strategy, policy, and innovation economics using data science and AI.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 9 years of experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis.
* 9 years of experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP), Large Language Models (LLMs), semantic search, or knowledge graph extraction.
* 9 years of experience working specifically with legal, technical, or patent datasets, including familiarity with patent taxonomies, citation networks, and prior art search methodologies.

**About the job**
-----------------

Help serve Google's worldwide user base of more than a billion people. Data Scientists provide quantitative support, market understanding and a strategic perspective to our partners throughout the organization. As a data-loving member of the team, you serve as an analytics expert for your partners, using numbers to help them make better decisions. You will weave stories with meaningful insight from data. You'll make critical recommendations for your fellow Googlers in Engineering and Product Management. You relish tallying up the numbers one minute and communicating your findings to a team leader the next.
  
  
Google’s Global Patents Team is an inspiring team of innovators and attorneys who are passionate about future technologies and excited about resolving their ensuing legal challenges. As a member of this team, you will have the unique opportunity to develop and implement Google's strategy to protect, defend and capture the value of Google’s technological innovation. You will dive into varied and interesting tasks that include patent-related protection, licensing, dispute resolution, acquisition, deals and policy work.
  
  
As a Senior Global Patents Data Scientist, you will be focusing on applied data and AI solution creations and experimentations. You will use a variety of tools and languages to make sense of large amounts of patent data, one of largest legal data corpus in history, generate AI enabled patent-specific applications, contribute to novel statistical and machine learning models, work closely with subject matter experts and stakeholders to constantly search for ways to make existing workflows and processes more efficient with AI.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive the implementation of patent AI transformation initiatives focusing on patent prosecution and patent transaction use cases.
* Apply patent and AI expertise to support patent engagement with the academic community and various patent offices on empirical patent and innovation studies and advise on AI implementations.
* Work with public patent data, internal data and tool stack to create custom AI solutions to support patent portfolio strategy, development, quality reviews and other patent workflows.
* Leverage patent expertise to develop internal patent transactions specific solutions to review third-party patent and licensing inquiries.
* Collaborate with outside counsel, internal legal team members, dedicated patent specialist vendors to achieve scaled impact.
